I farm only 7.8 mu, so I will keep the land use simple and stable. Because my main system is wheat-maize, I will put most of my land into that rotation and leave a smaller part for cotton. With some family labor going off-farm, I will avoid anything too labor-heavy or risky. I have 30 years of experience and well irrigation, so I will rely on improved or hybrid seed, steady fertilizer, and a moderate number of irrigations rather than gambling on very high input. Wheat and maize are still my backbone for grain and cash flow, and cotton stays on a smaller area because it needs more management and picking labor. For tillage, I will mostly use rotary tillage because it is practical for my scale and fits the rotation. I will aim for solid, realistic yields instead of chasing the highest possible output.
